<ic>Motion: of re-election for the position of Dean of Pilgrims of The Academy, to be held at Sunday's Senate, with the Former Cardinal of courage and previous Dean as a candidate for this position.<br><br>
<i>Proposed by Dean of the Academy, Seconded by Casinea</i></ic>

===Overview===
* This motion was to choose a citizen to appoint as [[Dean of Pilgrims]]

===Date===
* Autumn 380YE

===Campaign Outcome===
* Nina of Cantiarch's Hold was elected
